title: Sarah Grey smiles, with her stand-in's teeth
items: Sarah Grey of 2010 Prairie (1904) now smiles at you when you stand in front of her, and when she greets someone, as William does. The smile and the upper teeth are from a photograph of her stand-in smiling.
She keeps part of the smile while she talks, and her jaw moves with the talk. At rest her mouth is shut, as her other photographs show it, and her card's picture is unchanged.
Her lower teeth and tongue are not drawn yet, and nobody has a voice yet.
